text:
cora: Kickoff for Helix joint perf bench next Tue. Scope: watt-per-token, throughput sweep, and one kernel tuning pass in their lab. Need matrix, telemetry schema, and canary plan.

james: Proposed minimal matrix: models [redwood-3b,7b], quants [fp16,int8], batch [1,4], seq [512,1024], runs=3. Capture gpu_power_w, rack_power_w, tokens_s, p95_ms, energy_j_per_token.

mike: I'll own telemetry + CSV. Plan columns: run_id,model,quant,batch,seq,avg_gpu_w,rack_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes. Export to s3://partners/helix/3640123456/. Prom labels: model,quant,batch,seq,lab,rack,run_id.

cora: Kernel tune plan: baseline -> tune1 -> revert check -> final. Helix requires kernel blobs to stay in their lab; legal ok'd coop NDA.

anya: Legal: NDA signed; partner won't allow kernel artifacts to leave. Need a 1-page annex describing diffs, rollback, and emergency contacts. I'll draft it.

bench-bot: CI smoke ran: 2/3 passes, one OOM on run 2 (kv cache spike). Logs: s3://bench/helix/3640123456/logs.tar.gz. Created GH issue #7588 "Helix watt/token + kernel tune".

james: Add `--kv-flush` between iters and `--pdu-retry 3` in runbook. I'll open a PR with matrix + run commands today.

mike: Will push telemetry schema to the issue EOD and add the PromQL snippet for energy/token: `sum(rate(rack_power_w[1m]))/sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))`.

cora: Weekly sync scheduled Friday 3640127056. Goal: sign-off canary in Helix lab, telemetry in S3, marketing blurb placeholder ready. Thanks all.
